arguments.query: SELECT o.order_id,o.order_ts,o.status,i.quantity,i.unit_price_cents,p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LIMIT 8
SELECT order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 2
SELECT refund_ts, refund_amount_twd, item_id FROM refunds LIMIT 3
SELECT tier,count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY tier

WITH o AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.tier='S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025') SELECT (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM o)) AS gross, (SELECT SUM(refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM o)) AS refunds, (SELECT count(*) FROM o) n
